verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a first-party MCP server (mcp.ramp.com, live-verified via OAuth probe) explicitly for querying data and taking actions 'with natural language' from Claude/ChatGPT, plus a CLI with an agent mode, and both are documented in depth with scopes, guardrails, and sandbox testing. This directly satisfies natural-language operation for AI-native users beyond just API/CLI scripting. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of natural-language command usage in practice (only vendor docs and technical probes are cited).
